properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued July 9 at 12:38AM CDT until July 9 at 1:15AM CDT by NWS Topeka KS
properties.description:
SVRTOP

The National Weather Service in Topeka has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
North central Riley County in northeastern Kansas...
Southwestern Nemaha County in northeastern Kansas...
Northern Pottawatomie County in northeastern Kansas...
Southern Marshall County in northeastern Kansas...

* Until 115 AM CDT.

* At 1237 AM CDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Blue
Rapids, moving southeast at 40 mph. Another severe thunderstorm
was located near Frankfort, also moving southeast at 40 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Blue Rapids, Westmoreland, Blaine, Frankfort, Onaga, Waterville,
Olsburg, Randolph, Havensville, Wheaton, and Lillis.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

properties.description:

limits, and no longer poses an immediate threat to life or property.
Therefore, the warning will be allowed to expire.  However, gusty
winds and heavy rain are still possible with this thunderstorm.

southeastern Nebraska.
